post.caption:
Nobody wrote the rules for recognising a cat, because every rule you try has exceptions. Instead you build a network of weighted connections, set them randomly, let it guess, measure how wrong it was, and nudge every weight in the direction that would have been less wrong. A few million repetitions later it holds rules nobody wrote and nobody can read. Language models are the same machine predicting the next word. Whether prediction at that scale counts as understanding is genuinely unresolved.
